name: Yamato Yamamoto
source: A disillusioned but brave soldier, he fought in the wars against Zhina in the Imperial Army. Having been raised in Zipangu, he has no real knowledge of Europa or the terrain. His uncle is commander-in-chief of the Combo Fleet, Vice-Admiral Yamamoto. Sent to Germania as a spy for the military, he becomes personal advisor to the dictator Adorofia Hitora. Enjoys reading and fighting. Pretty relatable, huh?
